description: Main source file for the native_posix board in Zephyr OS, implementing initialization, execution, and fuzzing entry points for the native_posix environment.

methods.name: posix_exit
methods.description: Cleans up and exits the native_posix environment with the specified exit code.

methods.name: posix_init
methods.description: Performs early initialization of native_posix, including command line parsing and CPU start.

methods.name: posix_exec_for
methods.description: Runs the native_posix simulation for at least the specified microseconds.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the native_posix environment, runs the event loop.

methods.name: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput
methods.description: Entry point for fuzz testing, injects data as an interrupt and runs the simulation.
